budget.note: Every --check run on a distinct spec counts. Re-runs of identical spec bytes do not add an attempt.

attempts.note: First and only spec: 3 nodes / 2 edges, one region 'srv1', tb. extent 39x40, 0 warnings, 2/2 labels, 0 ambiguous owners, 0 crossings.

Three sibling regions (srv1, srv2, IPv4 103.19.91.56/29 holding gw + spare). --check was clean (extent 64x26) but the 77x47 dump shows the gateway outside its own region box: a region whose members sit in two ranks is not column-aligned with its own block, because each rank is centred on the widest rank, so the region-disjointness pass pushed that box into a right-hand sliver. Containment defect -> rejected. The saved spec reproduces the original --check output byte-for-byte (spec bytes had been overwritten; verified by identical output).

Containment fixed by keeping every region on one rank (srv1, srv2, address pool) and leaving the gateway ungrouped. Clean --check (extent 64x25) and clean capture, but promoted to attempt 3 only to add the source's 'no IPv6' limitation to the gateway label; kept as a raw record.

Final: gateway label '103.19.91.57 Arista, no v6' carries the OUI and the IPv4-only limitation. 77x47 probe dump first, then --check: extent 64x25, 0 warnings, 3/3 labels, 0 ambiguous owners, 0 crossings.

Whole egress chain in one view (gateway + 3 upstream hops, two regions). --check extent 44x49: taller than the 46-row canvas, so the top region border and its title are clipped off-canvas, and the two-rank regions also lost containment. Rejected; the saved spec reproduces the original output byte-for-byte.

Same chain with shorter tail labels ('7.1ms', '8.3-8.6ms') to buy rows: extent 44x47, still one row past the 46-row canvas. Rejected. This attempt's raw --check output was overwritten during iteration; it was re-run from the preserved identical spec bytes afterwards and reports the same extent (44x47). Recorded, not hidden.

Split at the DC boundary: v3 carries the gateway -> first Airtel hop only, one region 'DC edge' holding both nodes, 'L2? no hop' as a dashed parallel edge with minlen 2 so the unproven interior gets its own rank gap. Gateway label carries IP + AS + city. 77x47 probe dump first, then --check: extent 46x19, 0 warnings, 2/2 labels, 0 ambiguous owners, 0 crossings.

Observed upstream hops, region named 'upstream hops'. Clean --check (extent 41x36) and a clean capture, but the ANSI capture showed that region rendering the same aqua (81,113,106) as v3's 'DC edge' region. Renamed so the case has five distinct region hues.
Final: region renamed 'external hops', which the frozen binary paints blue (81,104,120) instead of aqua. extent 41x36, 0 warnings, 2/2 labels, 0 ambiguous owners, 0 crossings.
